holder_note: The legal name of the holder is not recorded in the repository. The identifier above is the one under which the OpenBinding repository is published; no name has been inferred or invented.

own_material.same_license_as: OpenBinding (the LICENSE file of that repository, Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International)
covers: packages/*/src (Python sources of bim-core, bim-service and bim-client)
packages/bim-core/hatch_build.py (the build hook that downloads and verifies the OMG schemas)
packages/bim-core/src/bim_core/resources/schemas (JSON Schemas and the engine contract, written for BIM)
golden (digests and numeric summaries computed by this toolchain; no dataset content)
does_not_cover: omg_bpmn_xsd (the five OMG BPMN 2.0.2 XML Schemas)
third-party dependencies (installed from an index, never vendored)
own_material.attribution: Credit javiercavlop (titular del repositorio OpenBinding), link the license (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/), and indicate if changes were made.

spdx_policy: The SPDX identifier is declared once per distribution in pyproject.toml (license = ...) and once here. It is deliberately not repeated in a header of every .py file: adding a comment to a module of bim_core would change compilerDigest (it covers every .py file) and the goldens that record it.
technical_note: CC BY 4.0 is not designed for software: it says nothing about patents, does not define source code or distribution of binaries, and its authors recommend other licenses for code. The holder chose the same license as OpenBinding on purpose; the risk is recorded here and in docs/LICENSING.md and the decision of the holder is untouched.

third_party.name: OMG BPMN 2.0.2 XML Schemas (BPMN20.xsd, Semantic.xsd, BPMNDI.xsd, DC.xsd, DI.xsd)
third_party.redistribution: not versioned in Git: downloaded from omg.org over https with SHA-256 verified at build time; wheels, sdists, the SDK and the images carry them, and including them in artifacts is a decision of the owner, taken on 2026-11-14 (the releases carry them; rights still not demonstrated)

third_party.name: Runtime and build dependencies (jsonschema, lxml, PyYAML, FastAPI, pydantic, uvicorn, httpx, hatchling)
third_party.license: each under its own license, see the metadata of the installed distribution
third_party.redistribution: not vendored: installed by pip or uv from an index

third_party.name: Material credited in THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md
third_party.license: as stated there (OpenBinding platform credits, copied unchanged)
third_party.redistribution: the text of the notice only; none of that code or those marks is part of this repository

omg_bpmn_xsd.cleared_format: To record that the rights are demonstrated the holder sets "cleared" to true, "status" to "cleared" and fills "cleared_by" (who), "cleared_on" (YYYY-MM-DD) and "evidence" (where the written confirmation of OMG, or the terms read, can be found). The record does not change how the files arrive: they are never versioned in Git (present_in_tree stays false) and are downloaded and verified at build time.

action_pins.reason: Each SHA is the commit that the major-version tag of the action pointed to on 2026-11-14, read from the GitHub API (repos/<action>/commits/<major>); the release tag at that commit is the trailing comment of every `uses:`.
